Description
The Credit Suisse 2-gram Gold Bar featuring the Statue of Liberty (New Assay) is a small, portable, and highly liquid investment option for gold bullion. The bar is made of 99.99% pure gold and is manufactured by Credit Suisse, a prestigious Swiss bank. The design features the Statue of Liberty, a symbol of freedom and democracy in the United States, making it a popular collector’s item. The new assay refers to the new packaging and certification process that Credit Suisse has introduced for these bars. The 2-gram weight of the bar makes it easy to buy and sell, and it is a great option for those looking for a small investment in physical gold.
